commands.name: join
commands.description: Register identity; reuse supplied ID. Presence lasts 60s: listen or heartbeat every 15s.

name.description: Unique live peer name; conflicts get a numeric suffix. Use the returned name.

vendorSession.description: Exact current host session ID; omit if unknown.

commands.name: heartbeat
commands.description: Renew live presence (60s, or ttlMs up to 10 min); optionally update task/status. renewLeases extends live owned leases; expired identities need resume and fresh leases.

vendorSession.description: Native session ID; use attach to change an existing receiver.

status.description: Current presence status visible to peers.

ttlMs.description: Presence lifetime in ms (default 60000, max 10 min, the lease cap). Raw CLI agents set it to cover their longest turn.

renewLeases.description: Extend currently live owned leases to at least the presence lifetime; never revive expired leases. Raw CLI identities and host-managed owners both use it.

branch.description: Git branch associated with this entry.

name.description: Rename; rejected while a live peer uses it.

commands.name: set_status
commands.description: Update your advertised task or status; does not renew presence.

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Resume expired same-vendor identity, deleting old leases; lock fresh before edits. Live sessions cannot be taken over.

commands.name: leave
commands.description: Expire your session and release its leases and delivery claims.

commands.name: prune
commands.description: Remove one batch of expired leases in this workspace; follow next. History is kept.

commands.name: peers
commands.description: Find live repository peers, including linked worktrees, with IDs, names, branches, tasks and status.

commands.name: send_message
commands.description: Send to fixed recipients. Returns a durable receipt; handling requires recipient completion.

to.description: Peer name/ID; "*" snapshots live repository peers except you.

replyRequired.description: Require a final result from each recipient.

commands.name: inbox
commands.description: Read pending mail without acknowledging it. For history, use records/read.

commands.name: complete
commands.description: Handle notices/results silently by message or messages. For requests, atomically reply with message, outcome and reply; retries must be unchanged.

reasoning.description: Reply purpose only; omit for silent completion.

commands.name: subscribe
commands.description: Replace subscriptions for future mail; [] unsubscribes. Pending mail stays; no backfill.

commands.name: lock
commands.description: Reserve one file or tree in this worktree before editing. Only ok:true grants a lease. On conflict, next retries with wait:true to queue; a later inbox notice reports the grant. Use lock_many for an atomic set.

ttlMs.description: Lifetime in ms; renew before expiry.

wait.description: Queue behind conflicts instead of failing.

commands.name: renew
commands.description: Extend a live owned lease; renewed:false requires reacquisition.

commands.name: unlock
commands.description: Release a live owned lease; queued contenders may then acquire it.

commands.name: db info
commands.description: Inspect the resolved path and compatibility without creating a database.

commands.name: db protocol
commands.description: SQLite-only client protocol and DDL, for other adapters. Opens no database.

commands.name: inbox wait
commands.description: Wait for inbox messages or timeout, without acknowledging. Explicit recovery only.

after.description: Exclusive continuation cursor copied from next.input; keep the same filters.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Typed stdio capability tools. Unbound connections expose init; --managed owns presence/cleanup and --session borrows the host identity. --tools limits capabilities.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Start managed Codex/Claude/Pi on request; host owns presence/delivery. --session resumes same-vendor expiry unless delivery is staged. Existing conversations: attach. Pi needs Node/model. --tools selects tools.

prompt.description: User task starting the managed worker.

commands.name: skill
commands.description: Read the companion skill; --vendor <host> returns its body without install frontmatter.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Discover commands, tools or record types without opening a database; schema types --compact gives every field, schema type <name> gives its schema and example.

commands.name: attach
commands.description: Bind existing receiver: raw; claude/grok same-user socket; codex owning loopback WebSocket/Unix socket; opencode idle workspace and loopback HTTP. OpenCode auth: listener env OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD, OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME, OCTOCODE_OPENCODE_AUTH_ENDPOINT. Grok needs ACP bridge.

endpoint.description: Host endpoint used for attached delivery.

vendorSession.description: Exact host session ID bound to this identity.

commands.name: dispatch
commands.description: Submit one DB batch to the attached native receiver. Codex/OpenCode defer busy recipients. Submission is not handling; attempts never replay automatically.

commands.name: hook
commands.description: Offer new host context; refresh presence. Formats: text (empty if idle), json (SDK), claude (UserPromptSubmit). Complete handled IDs; inspect failed delivery before retry.

deferConfirm.description: Acknowledge only after the host confirms submission.

consumer.description: Stable host lifecycle owner for inspecting staged delivery receipts.

managed.description: Host-managed lifecycle: renew presence and live leases without resuming expired identity.

deferConfirm.description: Acknowledge only after the host confirms submission.

commands.name: listen
commands.description: Maintain presence and dispatch native mail; raw uses hooks. No model calls or lease renewal.

commands.name: retry_delivery
commands.description: Reoffer one of your unacknowledged messages after inspecting its staged or uncertain attempt; may duplicate an uncertain write. A submitted attempt was accepted by the host and is refused. reason is audited.

commands.name: record_usage
commands.description: Record host token counters once per key, without text. scope: request, turn or cumulative (never sum cumulative). Missing means unknown, not zero.

key.description: Stable idempotency key; reuse only for unchanged input.

commands.name: confirm_delivery
commands.description: SDK context receipt: exact IDs and dispatch tokens required. Rejects stale tokens; work stays pending.

dispatchToken.description: Exact dispatch token returned by the delivery operation.

items.description: Exact delivery items and tokens returned by dispatch.

commands.name: host-hook
commands.description: Claude/Codex/Cursor/Grok stdin lifecycle JSON. Bind identity at session start; offer mail on supported post-tool events. Fails open; configure a timeout.

commands.name: host-config
commands.description: Preview Claude/Codex/Cursor/Grok messaging hook config with 10s timeouts; writes no settings or DB. Merge into the documented host location; separate edit guards are optional.

commands.name: lock_many
commands.description: Atomically reserve paths: ok:true grants all; conflict grants none. Conflict next queues with wait:true; await the grant notice.

wait.description: Queue behind conflicts instead of failing.

commands.name: share_document
commands.description: Publish immutable UTF-8 evidence and an optional discovery note; no notification. Retry unchanged; revisions need a new name.

supersedes.description: ADR: the published name this revises.

commands.name: read_document
commands.description: Read hash-verified UTF-8 pages by exact published name, including extension.

commands.name: context
commands.description: Find live discovery notes by path/branch; read their referenced documents for full evidence.

commands.name: activity
commands.description: Inspect worktree Git files, commits or reflog. Changes prove neither authorship nor lease ownership.

sinceMs.description: Inclusive start, epoch ms; excludes withinMs.

commands.name: check_paths
commands.description: Read live advisory write conflicts without acquiring leases. Follow next.command/input for every conflict, in lease ID order. ok describes the whole query at checkedAt, including conflicts before after; a clear result grants no ownership.

paths.description: Path targets to check or lease as one operation.

after.description: Exclusive lease ID cursor from next.input; each page reads current live conflicts.

commands.name: check_write
commands.description: Verify existing coverage of file targets without acquiring or renewing leases.

paths.description: Files to check; include both rename paths.

vendorSession.description: Optional host session ID; must match the bound identity.

commands.name: db export
commands.description: Verified SQLite/WAL snapshot to a new absolute path; no overwrite or symlinks. Document files are excluded.

path.description: Path within the repository; export paths must be absolute.

commands.name: db retention
commands.description: Read-only page of retention counts across workspaces: unresolved and settled messages expired before a cutoff (default 30 days). Deletes nothing.

before.description: Inclusive expiry cutoff, epoch ms ≤ now; keep across pages.

limit.description: Maximum items or bytes per page; follow next for remaining evidence.

commands.name: db compact
commands.description: SQLite VACUUM; keeps every record. Needs disk space and may fail on a busy writer; never run in a hook.

commands.name: schema tools
commands.description: Tool descriptors in canonical order, optionally narrowed with --tools.

commands.name: health
commands.description: Read-only delivery diagnostics; no retries/completion. Clear means no observed issue. Operator use; follow next.

staleAfterMs.description: Age in milliseconds after which delivery is stale.

limit.description: Maximum items or bytes per page; follow next for remaining evidence.

after.description: Exclusive continuation cursor copied from next.input; keep the same filters.

commands.name: completion-check
commands.description: Opt-in Claude/Pi completion check: read-only check of submitted, unacknowledged IDs; one recovery turn. Pass --session/--workspace/--database explicitly; stdin is hook JSON.

stop_hook_active.description: Whether completion recovery is already active.

session_id.description: Host session ID from the hook event.

cwd.description: Host working directory from the hook event.

commands.name: locks
commands.description: List reservations by owner or overlapping path. Results grant no ownership.

commands.name: view
commands.description: Read-only dashboard; no session. Use --workspace/--database. Stop: Ctrl+C.

port.description: Loopback port; 0 (default) selects a free port.

open.description: Open browser (default true); false prints URL.

commands.name: fetch
commands.description: Search repository history; mail is participant-only. incoming:true selects pending mail.

commands.name: record
commands.description: Append a memory, event or recovery checkpoint; no notification.

type.description: Record kind; distinct from the outer operation type.

commands.name: binding
commands.description: Inspect the bound host identity and current presence/branch without renewal; adapter preflight only, not a history query.

key.description: Stable idempotency key; reuse only for unchanged input.
Idempotency key; reuse only for unchanged input.

wake.description: action may wake an idle recipient; passive waits for a host boundary. Default: action for requests, passive for notices.

contextId.description: Related-work ID; final replies inherit it.

presence.description: Filter active, expired, or all presence.

vendorSession.description: Optional host session ID; must match the bound identity.

status.description: Current presence status visible to peers.

expiresAt.description: Presence deadline at this event; current liveness comes from peers.

kind.description: File or whole directory tree scope.

endpoint.description: Host endpoint used for attached delivery.

continuation.description: Executable continuation: run command with input unchanged.

budget.description: A single oversized row was returned intact; the target size was exceeded on purpose.

summary.description: One useful fact and why it matters.

branch.description: Exact branch; omit for branch-independent facts.

ttlMs.description: Discovery lifetime; default 1 day, max 7. Retries do not extend it.

checkpoint.description: The latest checkpoint record of the identity.

lease.description: A lease; expiresAt is on the response of a multi-path lock.

id.description: Lease ID; absent when the blocker is a queued wait.

lockRefused.description: Nothing acquired: the blocking lease and what to do next.

parts.description: Ordered content. Data is opaque; no automatic actions.

inboxPage.description: Pending deliveries in message ID order.

recordTypes.description: A new agent registers in this workspace; data is its complete identity/presence snapshot.
Identity or branch changes, presence shortens while still live, or expired presence resumes; full snapshot. Ordinary unchanged heartbeats create no event.
Explicit leave ends presence; same from/path and full agent snapshot as in. Clock expiry or a crash creates no synthetic out event.
Task or status changes; full identity/presence snapshot at that moment.
Immutable mail committed for fixed recipients. from is author; to is agent ID, topic:<topic>, or *. Complete uses data.messageId, never recordId.

key.description: Optional idempotency key; complete: prefix is reserved.

replyRequired.description: Whether each recipient owes a final result.

contentOmitted.description: Hook budget reference only; fetch data.messageId for the full payload.

next.description: Lossless continuation from an oversized hook reference; run unchanged with the current binding.

recordTypes.routing: author → fixed recipients; visible to message participants

recordTypes.description: A successful reservation commits. Full path/kind/deadline snapshot; from is lease owner.
A lease deadline changes. Full lease snapshot, including path/kind, without another lookup.
Unlock, leave or prune removes a lease. Full final snapshot; expiresAt is its former deadline, not removal time.
An agent starts receiving a topic; subscribe replaces its topic set.
An agent unsubscribes or leaves. Already-sent message recipients remain unchanged.
A host transport is registered for an agent. Endpoint may be null; registration does not prove delivery.
Host transport or its attachment metadata is refreshed; reattaching can emit this even without a transport change.
One fixed recipient is added to a message. from is recipient; to is original sender. This is storage, not submission or handling.
recordTypes.routing: recipient → original sender; visible to fixed message participants

recordTypes.description: A delivery owner claims one recipient/message for external delivery. owner is a dispatcher claim token, not an agent ID.
recordTypes.routing: recipient → original sender; visible to fixed message participants

recordTypes.description: Recipient completes handling; from is recipient, to original sender. This receipt is not proof of correctness or approval.
recordTypes.routing: recipient → original sender; visible to fixed message participants

recordTypes.description: A recipient/message attempt is reserved with token before external I/O. from is recipient, to original sender.
recordTypes.routing: recipient → original sender; visible to fixed message participants

recordTypes.description: The host transport accepted an attempt. Submission is not acknowledgement or guaranteed model consumption.
recordTypes.routing: recipient → original sender; visible to fixed message participants

recordTypes.description: Transport failed or its receipt is unknown; the message may have arrived. Inspect before explicit retry.
recordTypes.routing: recipient → original sender; visible to fixed message participants

recordTypes.description: Explicit retry reopens an unacknowledged delivery. token identifies the old attempt until the next stage replaces it.
recordTypes.routing: recipient → original sender; visible to fixed message participants

recordTypes.description: Immutable document publication metadata; content stays in data.path on disk. Optional context annotates indexed discovery.
Original host counters, once per key. scope is request, turn or cumulative; absent counters are unknown and cumulative values must not be summed.
Hook records offering this binding/context generation once. This is a receipt, not the injected text or proof it was read.

Claude hook report of the receiver's permission mode and visible crossSessionInbound setting, appended when either changes. Dispatch predicts whether Claude Code would hold or refuse peer socket messages from the latest report.
A retained fact: required content, optional tags/scopePath/expiry, plus arbitrary JSON. expiresAt is metadata; it does not auto-hide or delete records.

example.content: Case aliases conflict on all filesystems

recordTypes.description: A custom occurrence identified by name, plus arbitrary JSON; recording does not send notifications.
Checkpoint-resume state for continuing work after an interruption; resume and binding return your latest.

join.description: The new identity; name may carry a -2, -3 suffix.

resume.description: The revived identity with its latest checkpoint.

leave.description: Identity ended; leases, subscriptions and claims released.

prune.description: Expired leases removed; next continues when the batch was full.

peers.description: Live peers of the repository, by ID.

recipientOffline.description: The reply's recipient session had expired when it was sent.

oneOf.description: Final result stored and this recipient acknowledged atomically; other recipients remain independent.

complete.description: Either an acknowledgement of read messages or the receipt of a stored final reply.

lock.description: Lease acquired, or the conflict and how to queue.

renew.description: Lease extended, or a refusal to reacquire.

unlock.description: Whether an owned live lease was released.

db info.description: Database compatibility; the applied-schema fields are present when the file exists.

db protocol.description: The SQL protocol and schema identity.

inbox wait.description: Pending deliveries once any exist or the timeout passed (then items is empty).

mcp.description: One JSON-RPC response frame per request on standard output.

run.description: One JSON line per worker event.

skill.description: The operating guide and where the package lives.

results.description: The result schema of each command, keyed by command name.

attach.description: The delivery binding of the identity.

dispatch.description: The final delivery pass: nothing is in flight.

hook.description: JSON of the raw hook: format json prints items, context and action; claude prints hookSpecificOutput; text prints plain text, not JSON.

listen.description: One JSON line per event: the start notice, then each delivery pass that submitted mail.

retry_delivery.description: Whether the attempt was made ready again within the retry budget.

record_usage.description: Whether a new usage record was stored.

host-hook.description: The hook output the host reads: empty when there is nothing to add.

host-config.description: Hook settings to merge into the host configuration.

lock_many.description: All leases acquired, or none and the conflict.

share_document.description: The registered document; created false for an identical retry.

read_document.description: One verified page of document text.

context.description: Documents whose context notes cover the path.

activity.description: Observed Git and filesystem activity; grants no ownership.

check_paths.description: Live overlapping leases of other owners; grants nothing.

check_write.description: Own live coverage per concrete path.

db retention.description: Aged-record counts for one page; nothing is deleted.

schema tools.description: Tool definitions of the selected profile.

health.description: Delivery diagnostics; actions maps each issue present to its instruction.

completion-check.description: Empty to let the host stop; decision block lists unacknowledged message IDs.

active.description: 1 while the lease and its owner are live (an integer, as stored).

view.description: The loopback dashboard address, printed once.

through.description: Highest record ID in this view.

record.description: The stored record, or the existing one when the key was a retry.

binding.description: The bound identity with its coordination scope, liveness and latest checkpoint.
